# Octen Docs

> Octen is the search infrastructure for AI: a real-time web search foundation that lets LLMs, agents, and apps reason with the world's latest information. These are the official technical docs for the Octen API platform.

Every page in this index is linked with a `.md` extension and returns clean Markdown, which is what agents should fetch instead of the HTML page. `https://docs.octen.ai/llms-full.txt` contains the full text of every page in a single file. Requests to any page URL with `Accept: text/markdown` also return Markdown.

## Overview

- [Welcome](https://docs.octen.ai/overview/welcome.md): Real-time access to the world's latest information for LLMs and agents.
- [Introduction](https://docs.octen.ai/overview/introduction.md): What Octen is and what each API and application does.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.octen.ai/overview/quickstart.md): Get an API key and make your first search request in minutes.
- [Build with Coding Agent](https://docs.octen.ai/overview/build-with-coding-agent.md): What a coding agent needs to build an Octen integration.
- [Pricing](https://docs.octen.ai/overview/pricing.md): Monthly QPS plan subscription plus pay-as-you-go API billing.
- [Model Gateway Rebate](https://docs.octen.ai/overview/model-gateway-rebate.md): Get 15% of your Model Gateway spend back, automatically.

## Capabilities

### Octen Fast

- [Broad Search](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/broad-search.md): One question, many sub-queries, searched concurrently in a single call.
- [Web Search](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/web-search.md): Search the live web for ranked results with highlights and full content.
- [Image Search](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/image-search.md): Search the web for images by text query or reference image.
- [Video Search](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/video-search.md): Search the web for videos with ranked results and rich metadata.

### Octen Premier

- [News Search](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/news-search.md): Search live news with related coverage grouped into subjects.
- [Business Search](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/business-search.md): Search business content for companies and people as entity cards.

### Extract

- [Extract](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/extract.md): Turn any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or text.

### Model Gateway

- [Model Gateway](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/model-gateway.md): Frontier models behind one API key, with live web search built in.

### Embedding

- [Text Embedding](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/embedding.md): Turn text into semantic vectors with Octen's embedding models.
- [VL Embedding](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/vl-embedding.md): Encode text, images, and videos into one shared vector space.

### Applications

- [Answer](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/answer.md): Question to grounded, cited answer in one API call.
- [Deep Research](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/deep-research.md): Autonomous research agent that returns a cited, illustrated report.
- [Multimodal Chat](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/multimodal-chat.md): Chat answers interleaving text, images, and videos from live search.
- [Grounded Generation](https://docs.octen.ai/capabilities/grounded-generation.md): Generate images and videos grounded in real web references.

## Integrations

- [Octen Skills](https://docs.octen.ai/integrations/octen-skills.md): Add Octen skills to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents.
- [Octen MCP Server](https://docs.octen.ai/integrations/octen-mcp-server.md): Connect Octen to Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.
- [Octen CLI](https://docs.octen.ai/integrations/octen-cli.md): Wire Octen into your AI client and call the API from your terminal.
- [Connect Desktop AI Assistants](https://docs.octen.ai/integrations/connect-desktop-ai-assistants.md): Connect desktop AI assistants to Octen via MCP or Agent Skills.
- [Connect LLMs to Octen Search](https://docs.octen.ai/integrations/connect-llms-to-octen-search.md): Expose Octen Web Search as a function-calling tool for any LLM.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.octen.ai/integrations/python-sdk.md): Install and use the Octen Python SDK.

- [Changelog](https://docs.octen.ai/resources/changelog.md): Product updates, new features, bug fixes, and deprecation notices.

- [Rate Limits](https://docs.octen.ai/resources/rate-limits.md): QPS rate limits for each Octen API, by plan.
- [Error Codes](https://docs.octen.ai/resources/error-codes.md): Octen error codes, with the cause and fix for each.
- [Security & Compliance](https://docs.octen.ai/resources/security-&-compliance.md): How Octen handles customer data, security, and compliance.

## API Reference

### Octen Fast

- [Broad Search](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/broad-search.md): `POST /broad-search` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Web Search](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/search.md): `POST /search` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Image Search](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/image-search.md): `POST /image-search` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Video Search](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/video-search.md): `POST /video-search` parameters, request and response schema.

### Octen Premier

- [News Search](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/news-search.md): `POST /news-search` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Business Search](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/business-search.md): `POST /business-search` parameters, request and response schema.

### Extract

- [Extract](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/extract.md): `POST /extract` parameters, request and response schema.

### Model Gateway

- [LLM Chat (OpenAI-Compatible)](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/chat-completions.md): `POST /v1/chat/completions` parameters, request and response schema.
- [LLM Chat (Anthropic-Compatible)](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/messages.md): `POST /v1/messages` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Image Generation](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/images-generations.md): `POST /v1/images/generations` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Video Generation](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/post-video.md): `POST /v1/videos` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Video Download](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/get-video.md): `GET /v1/videos/{id}` request and response schema.

### Embedding

- [Embedding](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/embedding.md): `POST /embedding` parameters, request and response schema.

### VL Embedding

- [VL Embedding](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/vl-embedding.md): `POST /vl-embedding` parameters, request and response schema.

### Applications

- [Answer](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/answer.md): `POST /answer` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Deep Research](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/deep-research.md): `POST /v1/research` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Grounded Generation](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/post-grounded-generation.md): `POST /v1/grounded-generation` parameters, request and response schema.
- [Generation Result](https://docs.octen.ai/api-reference/get-grounded-generation.md): `GET /v1/grounded-generation/{generation_id}` request and response schema.

## Optional

- [API Platform](https://octen.ai/platform/api-keys): Create and manage API keys, credits, and QPS plans.
